product_metadata.title: mDesign Adjustable Kitchen Sink Dish Drying Mat/Grid - Soft Plastic Sink Protector, Cushions Sinks, Dishes - Quick Draining Pebble Design - Includes 1 Saddle, 2 Large Mats - Set of 3 - Black
features: SOFT PROTECTION: Sink saddle and sink mats keep kitchen sinks clean and scratch free; Perfect for double sink basins; Made of heavy, flexible plastic, the mats stay in place at the bottom of the sink to protect sink surfaces from scratches; The sink saddle is also made of flexible heavy and durable plastic to keep it secure on the sink divider; Pack of 3

CUSTOMIZED FIT: The plastic mat grips the sink and stays in place, no more sliding and slipping; The sink grid keeps dishes lifted off of sink surfaces so scratches and marring are a thing of the past; Cut out sections of the design for the sink drain or perfectly fit your sink size; Use in homes, apartments, condos, dorms, RVs, campers and cabins
IMPROVED DRAINAGE: The decorative organic design allows water to flow through so sinks don't become waterlogged or backed up; Water drains quickly and easily for faster air drying
QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of pliable water-safe PVC plastic; Easy Care - clean with mild soap and water; Do not place in dishwasher
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Each Sink Mat Measures: 15.75" x 12"; Sink Saddle Measures: 10" x 2" x 5"" high; Saddle fits over sink dividers up to 1.8" / 4.5cm thick
